verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local LLM inference runtime, so CPU instruction-set acceleration is a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, AMX or any CPU-specific optimization. Community notes that Ollama builds on llama.cpp or falls back to CPU are about other things and do not show this capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can leverage advanced x86 CPU instruction sets like AVX, AVX2, AVX512, and AMX for faster inference
